concepts.title: Compact high-field tokamak power
concepts.bounded_question: Can a compact high-field tokamak export dependable net electricity?
concepts.mechanism_status: Fusion and high-field magnets demonstrated separately
concepts.resource_ledger: Fusion fuel; heating, current drive, magnets, cooling and fuel-cycle loads must be included.
concepts.main_gap: Integrated wall loading, fuel sufficiency, exhaust, availability and cost.
concepts.next_investigation: Construct a whole-plant power ledger with uncertainty and an experimentally anchored confinement model.
concepts.coverage: Direct component evidence plus systems background.

concepts.title: Spherical tokamak power
concepts.bounded_question: Can low-aspect-ratio geometry improve whole-plant performance rather than just plasma metrics?
concepts.mechanism_status: Measured high-temperature spherical plasmas
concepts.resource_ledger: Fusion fuel and auxiliary plant electricity.
concepts.main_gap: Center-column engineering, shielding and sustained operation.
concepts.next_investigation: Compare equivalent net-output designs with common shielding and availability assumptions.
concepts.coverage: Direct plasma evidence.

concepts.title: Optimized stellarator power
concepts.bounded_question: Can optimized three-dimensional magnetic geometry support an economical steady power plant?
concepts.mechanism_status: Long-pulse stellarator confinement demonstrated
concepts.resource_ledger: Fusion fuel; magnet, heating, cooling and maintenance resources.
concepts.main_gap: Transport, alpha confinement, exhaust and maintainable coils.
concepts.next_investigation: Benchmark equilibrium and transport assumptions against measured devices before scaling.
concepts.coverage: Direct experimental and foundational sources.

concepts.title: Negative-triangularity and alternative plasma shaping
concepts.bounded_question: Can alternative shaping reduce exhaust and instability burdens at equal useful output?
concepts.mechanism_status: Plasma geometry is controllable; this subtopic needs dedicated evidence
concepts.resource_ledger: No new reservoir: geometry changes confinement and required control inputs.
concepts.main_gap: A dedicated positive/negative-triangularity comparison corpus remains to be assembled.
concepts.next_investigation: Retrieve matched experiments and integrated-design studies; compare transport, heat flux and wall-plug cost.
concepts.coverage: Background only for the specific shaping claim.

concepts.title: Field-reversed-configuration fusion
concepts.bounded_question: Can FRC confinement and sustainment be extended to a positive plant power balance?
concepts.mechanism_status: Formation of field-reversed plasmas demonstrated
concepts.resource_ledger: Fusion fuel minus neutral-beam and other sustainment loads.
concepts.main_gap: Confinement lifetime, particle losses and efficient sustainment.
concepts.next_investigation: Separate formation, heating and sustained-burn measurements from projected reactor output.
concepts.coverage: Direct confinement evidence.

concepts.title: Sheared-flow-stabilized Z-pinch
concepts.bounded_question: Can flow stabilization persist in a repetitive, useful-power Z-pinch?
concepts.mechanism_status: Neutron-producing stabilized discharges reported
concepts.resource_ledger: Fusion fuel and pulsed electrical driver.
concepts.main_gap: Stability scaling, electrodes, repetition and diagnostic interpretation.
concepts.next_investigation: Review shot-resolved energy input, neutron origin and stability across repeated runs.
concepts.coverage: Direct experimental seed.

concepts.title: Magnetized-target and magnetized-liner fusion
concepts.bounded_question: Can pre-magnetization reduce driver requirements sufficiently for repetitive net power?
concepts.mechanism_status: Fusion-relevant compressed magnetized conditions demonstrated
concepts.resource_ledger: Fusion fuel, preheat and compression-driver energy.
concepts.main_gap: Target production, driver efficiency and survivable repetition.
concepts.next_investigation: Compare full-cycle energy and material budgets, not just peak compressed conditions.
concepts.coverage: Direct experimental seed.

concepts.title: Laser inertial-fusion energy
concepts.bounded_question: Can target gain become net-electric, high-repetition operation?
concepts.mechanism_status: Target-level fusion gain demonstrated
concepts.resource_ledger: Fusion fuel; electricity-to-laser losses, targets, cooling and conversion.
concepts.main_gap: Efficient drivers, repetition, target cost, chamber survival and fuel cycle.
concepts.next_investigation: Build a consistent target-to-wall-plug-to-grid gain chain with realistic repetition assumptions.
concepts.coverage: Direct target evidence.

concepts.title: Proton-boron fusion
concepts.bounded_question: Can a specified p-B11 reactor overcome radiation and sustainment losses?
concepts.mechanism_status: Proton-boron reactions experimentally observed
concepts.resource_ledger: Nuclear fuel; include particle-distribution maintenance and energy conversion.
concepts.main_gap: Radiation, equilibration, confinement and useful energy conversion.
concepts.next_investigation: Pair modern reactivity calculations with opposing power-balance papers under identical distribution assumptions.
concepts.coverage: Direct reaction evidence; constraint derivations not yet fully audited.

concepts.title: Deuterium-deuterium fusion fuel cycle
concepts.bounded_question: Could D-D pathways reduce tritium-supply dependence at acceptable confinement and neutron cost?
concepts.mechanism_status: Underlying nuclear reactions established; atlas source is foundational
concepts.resource_ledger: Deuterium fuel and reaction products; auxiliary power and neutronics remain.
concepts.main_gap: Higher operating demands and reaction-product management.
concepts.next_investigation: Compare complete reaction-chain and material burdens with a D-T baseline.
concepts.coverage: Background only; dedicated fuel-cycle corpus needed.

concepts.title: Deuterium-helium-3 and other advanced fusion fuels
concepts.bounded_question: Can an advanced fuel provide useful net output after fuel procurement and side reactions?
concepts.mechanism_status: Known reaction channels; practical supply and reactor gaps
concepts.resource_ledger: Fuel supply plus confinement, handling and conversion energy.
concepts.main_gap: Scarce feedstocks, operating requirements and residual neutron-producing channels.
concepts.next_investigation: Test whether fuel procurement and full reaction-network losses erase the proposed benefit.
concepts.coverage: Background only; dedicated fuel and supply-chain evidence needed.

concepts.title: Muon-catalyzed fusion
concepts.bounded_question: Can realistic muon production, reuse and sticking losses permit net useful energy?
concepts.mechanism_status: Muon-catalyzed reactions are established
concepts.resource_ledger: Fusion fuel plus accelerator/muon-production energy.
concepts.main_gap: Muon lifetime, sticking, production efficiency and system throughput.
concepts.next_investigation: Calculate a closed per-muon energy budget using measured rather than ideal catalytic yields.
concepts.coverage: Historical experimental review plus recent theory.

concepts.title: Advanced fission SMRs and microreactors
concepts.bounded_question: Can modular manufacturing and operations deliver a lower-resource reliable nuclear supply?
concepts.mechanism_status: Fission power is established; each new design requires its own record
concepts.resource_ledger: Fissile fuel; manufacture, fuel services, cooling and decommissioning.
concepts.main_gap: Factory learning, licensing, fuel availability, security and real deployment economics.
concepts.next_investigation: Compare specific designs and demonstrated stages without treating an SMR label as performance evidence.
concepts.coverage: Academy systems assessment.

concepts.title: Fast reactors and closed fuel cycles
concepts.bounded_question: Can recycling and breeding greatly extend fuel usefulness with acceptable burdens?
concepts.mechanism_status: Fission mechanisms and components established; integrated claims are design-specific
concepts.resource_ledger: Fertile/fissile inventories and the complete reprocessing and fabrication chain.
concepts.main_gap: Economics, separations, waste, safeguards and institutional feasibility.
concepts.next_investigation: Compare fuel utilization, losses and lifecycle requirements across explicit cycle boundaries.
concepts.coverage: Academy background; detailed fuel-cycle audit pending.

concepts.title: Molten-salt reactors and liquid-fuel architectures
concepts.bounded_question: Can a selected liquid-fuel or salt-cooled design improve useful output and maintainability?
concepts.mechanism_status: Nuclear and molten-salt subcomponents have historical foundations
concepts.resource_ledger: Nuclear fuel plus pumps, chemistry control and material replacement.
concepts.main_gap: Salt chemistry, corrosion, maintenance and fuel management.
concepts.next_investigation: Keep salt-cooled and liquid-fuel systems separate and gather operating evidence for each.
concepts.coverage: Cross-design assessment; historical reactor records still needed.

concepts.title: Thorium-based fuel cycles
concepts.bounded_question: Can a defined thorium cycle improve long-horizon fuel availability and lifecycle outcomes?
concepts.mechanism_status: Fuel-conversion physics established; implementation-specific evidence required
concepts.resource_ledger: Thorium conversion requires a fissile driver and a complete fuel-cycle ledger.
concepts.main_gap: Full primary fuel-cycle corpus, startup inventory, recycle losses and waste comparison.
concepts.next_investigation: Retrieve IAEA-TECDOC-1450 and update its assumptions with measured contemporary cycle data.
concepts.coverage: Background only; IAEA technical-report lead recorded separately.

concepts.title: Accelerator-driven subcritical systems
concepts.bounded_question: Can external neutron driving yield a useful fuel or waste-management advantage after accelerator costs?
concepts.mechanism_status: Conceptual engineering framework exists
concepts.resource_ledger: Nuclear fuel plus accelerator electricity, targets and cooling.
concepts.main_gap: Accelerator reliability, beam power, target lifetime and integration.
concepts.next_investigation: Review the original energy-amplifier design and compare system availability against critical-reactor alternatives.
concepts.coverage: Historical report metadata plus broader systems context.

concepts.title: Fusion-fission hybrid systems
concepts.bounded_question: Can a fusion neutron source improve a fission fuel-cycle or waste objective enough to justify added complexity?
concepts.mechanism_status: Known reaction mechanisms; integrated proposal is not established here
concepts.resource_ledger: Both nuclear fuel streams, neutron-source power and coupled processing.
concepts.main_gap: Source duty cycle, coupled safety, fuel handling and economics.
concepts.next_investigation: Identify one bounded hybrid function and compare with a fission-only or accelerator-driven alternative.
concepts.coverage: Background only; dedicated hybrid literature not yet verified.

concepts.title: Enhanced geothermal systems
concepts.domain: Planetary heat, solar and other renewable gradients
concepts.bounded_question: Can engineered reservoirs deliver long-lived, widely deployable useful heat or electricity?
concepts.mechanism_status: Field experiments and operating experience support the mechanism
concepts.resource_ledger: Subsurface heat; drilling, stimulation, circulation and heat depletion.
concepts.main_gap: Reservoir lifetime, induced seismicity, water and site variation.
concepts.next_investigation: Analyze time-resolved production and circulation data rather than resource maps alone.
concepts.coverage: Direct government field-program evidence.

concepts.title: Superhot and supercritical geothermal
concepts.domain: Planetary heat, solar and other renewable gradients
concepts.bounded_question: Can very hot resources be accessed with durable wells and controlled fluid behavior?
concepts.mechanism_status: Geological modeling supports candidate resources
concepts.resource_ledger: Rock heat; high-temperature drilling, casing and surface-conversion loads.
concepts.main_gap: Permeability, material survival, fluid chemistry and sustainable extraction.
concepts.next_investigation: Separate modeled heat-in-place from recoverable output after downhole and surface losses.
concepts.coverage: Direct geoscience modeling plus drilling context.

concepts.title: Closed-loop geothermal
concepts.domain: Planetary heat, solar and other renewable gradients
concepts.bounded_question: Can sealed well loops provide economical heat or electricity across useful geological settings?
concepts.mechanism_status: Thermal extraction is physically established; economics depend on design
concepts.resource_ledger: Subsurface heat; conduction, pumping and well construction.
concepts.main_gap: Heat-transfer area and drilling cost; heating and electricity have different thresholds.
concepts.next_investigation: Reproduce selected published scenarios with transparent fluid, cost and lifetime assumptions.
concepts.coverage: Direct modeling and economic evidence.

concepts.title: Directed-energy deep drilling
concepts.domain: Planetary heat, solar and other renewable gradients
concepts.bounded_question: Can millimeter waves, lasers or plasma-assisted methods materially reduce cost per usable deep well?
concepts.mechanism_status: General drilling research is established; a specific deep-drilling system is not verified here
concepts.resource_ledger: External electricity converted to rock removal; heat reservoir is separate.
concepts.main_gap: Primary high-depth performance, debris removal, well completion and realistic energy cost.
concepts.next_investigation: Gather independent rock-removal, penetration and borehole-completion results before choosing a design.
concepts.coverage: Background only for the proposed drilling mechanisms.

concepts.title: Tandem and multijunction photovoltaics
concepts.domain: Planetary heat, solar and other renewable gradients
concepts.bounded_question: Can higher spectral utilization produce durable, low-resource photovoltaic systems?
concepts.mechanism_status: High-efficiency research cells demonstrated
concepts.resource_ledger: Sunlight; materials, module manufacture, balance of system and storage.
concepts.main_gap: Stability, scale-up, critical materials, recycling and field yield.
concepts.next_investigation: Compare lifetime energy yield per material and installed area, not champion-cell efficiency alone.
concepts.coverage: Direct cell evidence.

concepts.title: Singlet-fission-enhanced photovoltaics
concepts.domain: Planetary heat, solar and other renewable gradients
concepts.bounded_question: Can exciton multiplication yield a net device-level efficiency improvement?
concepts.mechanism_status: Exciton generation and transfer demonstrated
concepts.resource_ledger: High-energy solar photons; molecular/semiconductor interfaces.
concepts.main_gap: Transfer losses, interface durability and full-cell current-voltage performance.
concepts.next_investigation: Measure power conversion and lifetime against an otherwise identical control cell.
concepts.coverage: Direct mechanism evidence.

concepts.title: Hot-carrier photovoltaics
concepts.domain: Planetary heat, solar and other renewable gradients
concepts.bounded_question: Can hot carriers be extracted before their excess energy is dissipated?
concepts.mechanism_status: Mechanism-specific measurements and models exist
concepts.resource_ledger: Photon energy and selective-contact architecture.
concepts.main_gap: Carrier cooling, selective contacts and practical illumination intensity.
concepts.next_investigation: Distinguish carrier-temperature evidence from an end-to-end conversion advantage.
concepts.coverage: Direct recent mechanism seed.

concepts.title: Space-based solar power
concepts.domain: Planetary heat, solar and other renewable gradients
concepts.bounded_question: Can orbital collection and power transmission outperform terrestrial alternatives on a lifecycle basis?
concepts.mechanism_status: Physics-compatible architecture; integrated assessment rather than deployment proof
concepts.resource_ledger: Sunlight; launch, assembly, transmission losses, replacement and receivers.
concepts.main_gap: Launch/maintenance burden, wireless transmission, safety and cost.
concepts.next_investigation: Reproduce architecture comparisons with sensitivity to launch cadence and service lifetime.
concepts.coverage: Direct architecture assessment.

concepts.title: Wave-energy conversion
concepts.domain: Planetary heat, solar and other renewable gradients
concepts.bounded_question: Can robust wave devices deliver valuable power after maintenance and survivability constraints?
concepts.mechanism_status: Wave resources and conversion mechanisms are recognized
concepts.resource_ledger: Ocean waves driven largely by winds; moorings, storms and servicing.
concepts.main_gap: Survival, availability, mooring cost and ecological effects.
concepts.next_investigation: Screen sea-trial datasets and distinguish theoretical resource from practical capacity.
concepts.coverage: Government resource framework; device-specific papers pending.

concepts.title: Tidal-stream and ocean-current generation
concepts.domain: Planetary heat, solar and other renewable gradients
concepts.bounded_question: Can predictable marine flows support scalable generation at acceptable ecosystem cost?
concepts.mechanism_status: Known kinetic-energy conversion mechanisms
concepts.resource_ledger: Gravitational/rotational tidal forcing or ocean circulation; flow depletion and infrastructure.
concepts.main_gap: Array interactions, resource limits, underwater servicing and ecosystems.
concepts.next_investigation: Combine hydrodynamic resource estimates with extraction feedback and measured availability.
concepts.coverage: Government resource framework; device-specific papers pending.

concepts.title: Ocean thermal energy conversion
concepts.domain: Planetary heat, solar and other renewable gradients
concepts.bounded_question: Can small ocean temperature gradients provide useful net output after pumping?
concepts.mechanism_status: Heat-engine mechanism established; specific systems require review
concepts.resource_ledger: Warm surface water and colder deep water; heat exchangers and pumps.
concepts.main_gap: Small temperature differences and large water-throughput burdens.
concepts.next_investigation: Screen net rather than gross power and include cold-water-pipe construction.
concepts.coverage: Background only; dedicated OTEC system corpus pending.

concepts.title: Salinity-gradient and osmotic power
concepts.domain: Planetary heat, solar and other renewable gradients
concepts.bounded_question: Can scalable membranes convert mixing free energy while resisting fouling?
concepts.mechanism_status: Nanopore energy conversion demonstrated
concepts.resource_ledger: Separated salt/fresh-water streams; pretreatment, pumping and gradient replenishment.
concepts.main_gap: Membrane-area scaling, concentration polarization, fouling and salinity sources.
concepts.next_investigation: Replace per-pore normalization with net power per installed membrane and complete operating cycle.
concepts.coverage: Direct nanoscale seed.

concepts.title: Artificial and biohybrid photosynthesis
concepts.domain: Planetary heat, solar and other renewable gradients
concepts.bounded_question: Can artificial or hybrid biological systems make fuels and materials with favorable lifecycle energy?
concepts.mechanism_status: Solar-to-chemical laboratory systems demonstrated
concepts.resource_ledger: Sunlight and feedstocks; product separation, nutrients, water and catalyst replacement.
concepts.main_gap: Durability, productivity, separation energy and biological control.
concepts.next_investigation: Compare delivered chemical exergy per input resource with photovoltaic-electrochemical baselines.
concepts.coverage: Direct experimental seed.

concepts.title: High-field superconducting magnets and robust conductors
concepts.bounded_question: Can better conductors and magnet engineering unlock more useful confinement and power infrastructure?
concepts.mechanism_status: Representative high-field REBCO coils demonstrated
concepts.resource_ledger: No new fuel: magnet production, cryogenics, protection and replacement enter the ledger.
concepts.main_gap: Stress, irradiation, quench behavior, joints and conductor cost.
concepts.next_investigation: Compare magnet lifetime and total support power per unit of useful field in the intended environment.
concepts.coverage: Direct magnet and material evidence.

concepts.title: Ambient-pressure high-temperature superconductivity
concepts.bounded_question: Can reproducible ambient-condition superconductors enable practical power and magnet applications?
concepts.mechanism_status: High-temperature superconductivity under pressure is not the desired ambient result
concepts.resource_ledger: Reduced electrical losses, offset by manufacturing, operating and mechanical requirements.
concepts.main_gap: Reproducibility, pressure dependence, current density and usable bulk fabrication.
concepts.next_investigation: Require independent transport, magnetic and structural evidence under the claimed operating conditions.
concepts.coverage: Direct adjacent evidence, not proof of the target material.

concepts.title: Magnetic topology, helicity and knotted-field confinement
concepts.bounded_question: Can topology-informed design improve confinement without increasing transport or control costs?
concepts.mechanism_status: Self-organized magnetic structures appear in MHD simulations
concepts.resource_ledger: Magnetic and plasma energy supplied by known sources; reconnection and resistive losses remain.
concepts.main_gap: Simulation-to-device validity and transport properties at fusion-relevant conditions.
concepts.next_investigation: Compare topology metrics with measured loss and stability metrics rather than visual knot complexity.
concepts.coverage: Direct simulation seed.

concepts.title: Direct charged-particle energy conversion
concepts.bounded_question: Can charged reaction products be converted to electricity with less loss than an indirect thermal cycle?
concepts.mechanism_status: Compatible with known electrodynamics; this source set is foundational
concepts.resource_ledger: Kinetic energy of externally generated particles; collection and conditioning losses.
concepts.main_gap: Particle distributions, space charge, radiation and capture efficiency.
concepts.next_investigation: Find measured converter performance and integrate it with a realistic reaction-product spectrum.
concepts.coverage: Background only; converter experiments need targeted retrieval.

concepts.title: Magnetohydrodynamic power conversion
concepts.bounded_question: Can conducting-fluid or plasma MHD conversion improve a specified plant energy balance?
concepts.mechanism_status: Electromagnetic conversion mechanism is established
concepts.resource_ledger: Flow or thermal energy of a working fluid; ionization and magnet overhead.
concepts.main_gap: Electrode losses, conductivity, corrosion and conditioning power.
concepts.next_investigation: Compare electrical output against all fluid preparation and magnetic support inputs.
concepts.coverage: Background only; system-specific operating records pending.

concepts.title: Superconducting magnetic energy storage
concepts.bounded_question: Can SMES supply a useful storage service with competitive lifecycle and cryogenic costs?
concepts.mechanism_status: Magnetic field storage is established; application-scale claims are design-specific
concepts.resource_ledger: Electricity stored in a magnetic field; cooling, conversion and protection draw energy.
concepts.main_gap: Cryogenics, mechanical stress, stored-energy safety and storage duration.
concepts.next_investigation: Compare full round-trip efficiency and installed cost for the required response time and duration.
concepts.coverage: Foundational and component sources.

concepts.title: Magnetocaloric and other caloric cooling
concepts.bounded_question: Can caloric cycles reduce cooling energy at realistic load and lifetime?
concepts.mechanism_status: Large magnetic entropy changes demonstrated
concepts.resource_ledger: Work-driven transfer of heat; field cycling, fluid flow and regeneration losses.
concepts.main_gap: Hysteresis, heat-transfer rates, fatigue and system coefficient of performance.
concepts.next_investigation: Compare whole-appliance electricity at matched cooling duty, not material entropy change alone.
concepts.coverage: Direct material mechanism evidence.

concepts.title: Thermoelectrics and phonon engineering
concepts.bounded_question: Can materials decouple heat and charge transport enough to recover otherwise unusable heat?
concepts.mechanism_status: Thermoelectric conversion is established
concepts.resource_ledger: Existing temperature gradients; heat-source access and heat-sink provision.
concepts.main_gap: Material figure of merit versus contact, module and heat-exchanger losses.
concepts.next_investigation: Benchmark complete modules over real duty cycles and account for critical-material demand.
concepts.coverage: Review background; targeted modern benchmarks needed.

concepts.title: Thermophotovoltaics and heat-to-electric storage
concepts.bounded_question: Can hot storage coupled to TPV deliver attractive full-cycle electricity storage or heat recovery?
concepts.mechanism_status: High cell-level conversion efficiency demonstrated
concepts.resource_ledger: Externally supplied high-temperature heat; storage, emitter and cooling losses.
concepts.main_gap: Round-trip performance, insulation, emitter life and thermal cycling.
concepts.next_investigation: Connect charging, standby and discharge losses in a measured common-boundary energy budget.
concepts.coverage: Direct converter evidence plus storage context.

concepts.title: Near-field thermal radiation and evanescent transport
concepts.bounded_question: Can engineered nanoscale gaps improve useful thermal conversion or cooling?
concepts.mechanism_status: Enhanced nanoscale radiative transfer observed
concepts.resource_ledger: Heat flowing between nonequilibrium bodies; gap control and parasitic conduction.
concepts.main_gap: Maintaining uniform gaps, useful area and material stability.
concepts.next_investigation: Measure net system improvement after gap-control, conduction and surface-degradation costs.
concepts.coverage: Direct physical-mechanism seed.

concepts.title: Magnons, spintronics and magnetic quasiparticle transport
concepts.bounded_question: Can collective spin excitations reduce energy per specified information-processing task?
concepts.mechanism_status: Magnon information transport demonstrated
concepts.resource_ledger: Excitation and transduction energy; no independent source of energy is implied.
concepts.main_gap: Injection/readout loss, propagation length and useful logic integration.
concepts.next_investigation: Compare task-level energy including electrical-to-spin and spin-to-electrical conversion.
concepts.coverage: Direct transport seed.

concepts.title: Polaritons, cavity chemistry and engineered light-matter phases
concepts.bounded_question: Can light-matter coupling alter useful reactions or transport reproducibly enough to reduce process energy?
concepts.mechanism_status: Mechanism-specific cavity chemistry effects have been reported
concepts.resource_ledger: Chemical free energy and cavity/control resources; no vacuum fuel is assumed.
concepts.main_gap: Reproducibility, mechanism attribution and scalable chemical throughput.
concepts.next_investigation: Pair positive studies with replication attempts and off-resonant, thermal and geometrical controls.
concepts.coverage: Direct experimental seed; replication landscape not yet mapped.

concepts.title: Quantum batteries and collective charging
concepts.bounded_question: Can collective effects improve usable storage service after charging and discharge costs?
concepts.mechanism_status: Collective absorption and charging signatures demonstrated
concepts.resource_ledger: External charging field; excitation energy, decoherence and energy extraction.
concepts.main_gap: Extractable work, retention, cycling and charger efficiency.
concepts.next_investigation: Distinguish fast absorption from demonstrably recoverable electrical work across repeated cycles.
concepts.coverage: Direct mechanism seed.

concepts.title: Long-duration mechanical, electrochemical and thermal storage
concepts.bounded_question: Can storage make intermittent supply dependable with acceptable material and energy overhead?
concepts.mechanism_status: Several storage mechanisms are demonstrated; novel scale claims vary
concepts.resource_ledger: Previously generated energy; charging, standby, discharge and replacement losses.
concepts.main_gap: Duration, degradation, siting, critical minerals and system reliability.
concepts.next_investigation: Compare service-equivalent storage portfolios rather than cost per nominal capacity alone.
concepts.coverage: Government research roadmap; technology-specific datasets pending.

concepts.title: Hydrogen, ammonia and synthetic chemical energy carriers
concepts.bounded_question: Can chemical carriers economically shift or transport energy without excessive conversion loss?
concepts.mechanism_status: Carrier chemistry is established; lifecycle advantage is conditional
concepts.resource_ledger: Electricity/heat and feedstocks used to manufacture the carrier; handling and reconversion.
concepts.main_gap: Production, compression or synthesis, transport leakage and reconversion.
concepts.next_investigation: Compare delivered service with direct electrification under an identical energy-source mix.
concepts.coverage: Background and adjacent solar-chemical evidence; carrier-specific corpus pending.

concepts.title: Heat pumps, exergy matching and cascaded energy use
concepts.bounded_question: Can matching energy quality to service reduce avoidable primary-energy use?
concepts.mechanism_status: Work-driven heat transfer is an established mechanism
concepts.resource_ledger: Electrical work plus environmental or waste heat; temperatures and losses define performance.
concepts.main_gap: Application temperatures, seasonal performance and system integration.
concepts.next_investigation: Use service-matched seasonal and lifecycle metrics; a heat pump does not create energy.
concepts.coverage: Background only for a full heat-pump/cascade assessment.

concepts.title: Static-magnet-only cyclic power claims
concepts.discovery_class_label: Conflicts with established constraints under the specified formulation
concepts.bounded_question: Can an unchanged permanent-magnet arrangement supply continuing cyclic work without another input?
concepts.mechanism_status: Conservative full-cycle accounting constrains the proposed formulation
concepts.resource_ledger: Claim assumes no consumed magnetic, mechanical, chemical, electrical or thermal resource.
concepts.main_gap: The formulation omits a replenishing energy source or irreversible change in the apparatus.
concepts.next_investigation: Audit the complete reset cycle and all hidden inputs; a different driven mechanism would be a different claim.
concepts.coverage: Foundational constraint sources.

concepts.title: AI-assisted plasma prediction and feedback
concepts.bounded_question: Can learned controllers improve plasma performance and robustness against defined baselines?
concepts.mechanism_status: A bounded learned-control application demonstrated experimentally
concepts.resource_ledger: Compute and actuators consume power; benefit comes from better plant operation.
concepts.main_gap: Transfer across devices, uncertainty, distribution shifts and actuator limits.
concepts.next_investigation: Use held-out shots, uncertainty calibration and classical safety/control baselines.
concepts.coverage: Direct experimental evidence.

concepts.title: Differentiable simulators and reduced-order digital twins
concepts.bounded_question: Can validated fast models improve experiment and engineering decisions?
concepts.mechanism_status: Software and modeling frameworks exist
concepts.resource_ledger: Compute/training expense traded against experimental and operational savings.
concepts.main_gap: Surrogate bias and uncertainty outside training conditions.
concepts.next_investigation: Benchmark conserved quantities, predictive accuracy and latency on independently held-out data.
concepts.coverage: Application seeds plus official software documentation.

concepts.title: AI-guided materials discovery
concepts.bounded_question: Can candidate discovery increase the rate of experimentally verified useful materials?
concepts.mechanism_status: Computational screening and some synthesis-linked workflows demonstrated
concepts.resource_ledger: Compute, synthesis and characterization resources.
concepts.main_gap: Synthesis feasibility, novelty, deployment properties and independence of validation. Corrected phase identification, genuine novelty and independent experimental validation must be distinguished from automated output.
concepts.next_investigation: Measure successful independent syntheses and service-relevant properties per experimental budget.
concepts.coverage: Direct computational and experimental workflow evidence.

concepts.title: Autonomous and self-driving laboratories
concepts.bounded_question: Can closed-loop automation produce reproducible discoveries more efficiently than a strong baseline?
concepts.mechanism_status: Autonomy demonstrated within bounded experimental workflows
concepts.resource_ledger: Robotics, consumables, instrumentation, compute and human oversight.
concepts.main_gap: Reliable identification, generalization, safety and independent verification. Corrected phase identification, genuine novelty and independent experimental validation must be distinguished from automated output.
concepts.next_investigation: Compare blinded reproducibility and useful discoveries per total resource input.
concepts.coverage: Direct laboratory workflow evidence.

concepts.title: Active learning and value-of-information experiment selection
concepts.bounded_question: Can choosing the next informative experiment outperform broad trial-and-error screening?
concepts.mechanism_status: Experiment-selection methods appear in bounded autonomous workflows
concepts.resource_ledger: Experimental and computational budgets rather than a new energy reservoir.
concepts.main_gap: Exploration bias, misleading uncertainty and out-of-distribution hypotheses.
concepts.next_investigation: Preregister a discovery/uncertainty metric and compare against random, expert and conventional optimization baselines.
concepts.coverage: Experimental workflow and methodological seeds.

concepts.title: AI-assisted symbolic theory and formal verification
concepts.bounded_question: Can machine-generated models and machine-checked mathematics produce testable, useful energy-science insights?
concepts.mechanism_status: General proposal; domain-specific validation remains to be gathered
concepts.resource_ledger: Compute and independent proof/experiment checking.
concepts.main_gap: Correctness, identifiability, novelty and physical interpretability.
concepts.next_investigation: Require independent derivation checks and new predictions; fit quality alone is not a physical explanation.
concepts.coverage: Methodological/adjacent sources only; dedicated theory-discovery corpus pending.

concepts.title: AGI as a general scientific-discovery accelerator
concepts.bounded_question: Could broadly capable autonomous reasoning accelerate discovery across unrelated physical domains?
concepts.mechanism_status: No general capability is established by the bounded examples in this atlas
concepts.resource_ledger: Training/inference, laboratories, data acquisition and verification resources.
concepts.main_gap: Operational definition, generalization and measurable counterfactual discovery acceleration.
concepts.next_investigation: Define a reproducible cross-domain benchmark before assigning likelihood or energy benefits.
concepts.coverage: Adjacent bounded-AI examples, not direct AGI validation.

concepts.title: Fault-tolerant quantum chemistry and materials simulation
concepts.bounded_question: Can quantum methods provide useful chemistry predictions beyond competitive classical methods?
concepts.mechanism_status: Concrete algorithms and resource estimates exist
concepts.resource_ledger: Quantum hardware, error correction, control and cooling costs.
concepts.main_gap: End-to-end resources, precision, verification and changing classical baselines.
concepts.next_investigation: Choose an industrially relevant observable and include data preparation and output extraction in the resource estimate.
concepts.coverage: Direct resource-estimation and hardware-component evidence.

concepts.title: Quantum algorithms for plasma, transport and turbulence
concepts.bounded_question: Can a specified quantum subroutine improve a plasma-relevant task end to end?
concepts.mechanism_status: Proposals face important algorithm-specific complexity constraints
concepts.resource_ledger: Input loading, circuit depth, error correction, measurement and classical post-processing.
concepts.main_gap: Nonlinearity, chaos, readout and real-time latency.
concepts.next_investigation: Test the proposed subproblem against the theorem assumptions and a current classical baseline.
concepts.coverage: Direct constraint seed plus physical background.

concepts.title: Adaptive quantum error correction and decoherence modeling
concepts.bounded_question: Can adaptive noise models and decoding reduce logical error and system overhead?
concepts.mechanism_status: Below-threshold logical-memory error suppression demonstrated
concepts.resource_ledger: Measurement, reset, decoding, control and refrigeration energy.
concepts.main_gap: Correlated noise, nonstationarity, decoder latency and scaling.
concepts.next_investigation: Compare logical error per operation and complete overhead; do not assume prediction of each random error is necessary.
concepts.coverage: Direct error-correction evidence; AI-decoder-specific corpus pending.

concepts.title: Majorana and other non-Abelian topological computation
concepts.bounded_question: Can a specified topological platform reduce fault-tolerant computing overhead?
concepts.mechanism_status: Engineered non-Abelian operations demonstrated; material implementations need separate evidence
concepts.resource_ledger: Fabrication, cooling, readout and non-protected operations.
concepts.main_gap: Unambiguous quasiparticles, gates, leakage and full universality.
concepts.next_investigation: Distinguish simulation, encoded circuit demonstrations and material-based braiding; compare complete logical resources.
concepts.coverage: Direct circuit evidence, not a blanket validation of Majorana hardware.

concepts.title: Fracton and self-correcting quantum memories
concepts.bounded_question: Can constrained-mobility codes improve finite-temperature memory at realistic hardware cost?
concepts.mechanism_status: Mathematical model results, not indefinite physical storage
concepts.resource_ledger: Many-body interactions, preparation, cooling and remaining active correction.
concepts.main_gap: Implementability, finite-size regime and noise-model validity.
concepts.next_investigation: Test lifetimes with realistic local noise and compare to simpler error-correcting memories.
concepts.coverage: Direct theoretical seed.

concepts.title: Floquet engineering and time-crystalline order
concepts.bounded_question: Can a driven many-body phase improve synchronization or logical reliability enough to justify its overhead?
concepts.mechanism_status: Driven time-crystalline order experimentally demonstrated
concepts.resource_ledger: Periodic driving, control and dissipation management.
concepts.main_gap: Lifetime, usable timing quality and cost relative to conventional clocks/control.
concepts.next_investigation: Benchmark real timing or error suppression with the drive counted; persistent oscillation is not free energy.
concepts.coverage: Direct demonstration plus scoped equilibrium no-go source.

concepts.title: Tensor networks and holographic quantum codes
concepts.bounded_question: Can structured representations reduce cost for a specified physical problem without unacceptable information loss?
concepts.mechanism_status: Mathematical encoding models established
concepts.resource_ledger: Memory, computation, encoding, decoding and measurement costs.
concepts.main_gap: Task-specific compressibility, reconstruction accuracy and noise.
concepts.next_investigation: Compare reconstruction and prediction at equal resources; do not infer generic compression from a geometric analogy.
concepts.coverage: Direct theory seeds.

concepts.title: Quantum sensing and precision metrology
concepts.bounded_question: Can improved sensing reveal accessible reservoirs or reduce control and measurement uncertainty?
concepts.mechanism_status: Specific particle and field measurements demonstrated
concepts.resource_ledger: Sensor excitation, cooling, readout and background rejection.
concepts.main_gap: Sensitivity versus bandwidth, interference and integration costs.
concepts.next_investigation: Choose a measurable control or discovery benefit rather than using sensitivity alone as an energy metric.
concepts.coverage: Direct measurement examples.

concepts.title: Equilibrium vacuum and zero-point energy extraction
concepts.discovery_class_label: Conflicts with established constraints under the specified formulation
concepts.bounded_question: Can a cyclic device extract continuing net work from an unchanged equilibrium vacuum with no other consumed resource?
concepts.mechanism_status: Vacuum phenomena exist, but the cyclic free-power formulation is constrained
concepts.resource_ledger: Claim excludes all drives, state preparation, reservoirs and irreversible apparatus changes.
concepts.main_gap: Under the stated passivity assumptions there is no available cyclic work resource.
concepts.next_investigation: Write the full Hamiltonian and cycle; identify the precise assumption escaped by any proposed counterexample.
concepts.coverage: Foundational constraint plus contrasting driven experiment.

concepts.title: Dynamical Casimir and engineered quantum-field boundaries
concepts.bounded_question: Can controlled boundary changes provide useful quantum conversion, sensing or communication?
concepts.mechanism_status: Driven photon generation demonstrated
concepts.resource_ledger: External modulation supplies energy; vacuum fluctuations participate in the dynamics.
concepts.main_gap: Conversion efficiency, pump noise and useful output.
concepts.next_investigation: Include pump energy and compare with conventional parametric devices at the same task.
concepts.coverage: Direct experimental seed and thermodynamic boundary.

concepts.title: Quantum heat engines and nonequilibrium reservoirs
concepts.bounded_question: Can quantum resources improve an explicitly defined conversion task after preparation costs?
concepts.mechanism_status: Specific quantum engines experimentally realized
concepts.resource_ledger: Prepared quantum states, controlled interactions and external drives or gradients.
concepts.main_gap: Reset, control and resource preparation can dominate small work outputs.
concepts.next_investigation: Compare work and efficiency with a resource-matched classical engine, not an unmatched thermal baseline.
concepts.coverage: Direct experiment plus passivity framework.

concepts.title: Quantum energy teleportation
concepts.bounded_question: Can local operations and correlations provide a useful energy-control or information function?
concepts.mechanism_status: Model protocols exist
concepts.resource_ledger: Local energy injection, measurement, classical communication and extraction.
concepts.main_gap: Operational usefulness, finite-speed communication and a complete energy ledger.
concepts.next_investigation: Reproduce one protocol with all measurement, preparation and resetting costs explicit.
concepts.coverage: Direct theoretical seed.

concepts.title: Ambient neutrino energy harvesting
concepts.bounded_question: Can any specified interaction channel deliver useful net power from ambient neutrino flux?
concepts.mechanism_status: Neutrino interactions are measurable; useful harvesting is not demonstrated here
concepts.resource_ledger: Incident neutrino flux; interaction cross-section, recoil energy and detector overhead.
concepts.main_gap: Small deposited energy and interaction rates, plus material and cooling cost.
concepts.next_investigation: Calculate flux times capture probability times recoverable event energy before considering device claims.
concepts.coverage: Direct interaction evidence, not a power-harvesting demonstration.

concepts.title: Axion-photon conversion
concepts.bounded_question: Could an axion field be converted into useful electromagnetic energy?
concepts.mechanism_status: Searches constrain candidates; the required dark matter particle is unconfirmed
concepts.resource_ledger: Hypothesized field density and coupling; resonator/magnet/cooling costs.
concepts.main_gap: Existence, allowed coupling, bandwidth and accessible power.
concepts.next_investigation: Use measured exclusion curves and specify a surviving model before estimating energy yield.
concepts.coverage: Direct particle-search evidence, not discovery.

concepts.title: Dark photons and other weakly coupled hidden fields
concepts.bounded_question: Could a hidden field couple to an engineered material strongly enough for useful conversion?
concepts.mechanism_status: Candidate searches and sensor networks exist
concepts.resource_ledger: Hypothesized local field energy; conversion coupling and detector resources.
concepts.main_gap: Existence, coupling constraints, frequency range and background signals.
concepts.next_investigation: Build a model-specific detection and recoverable-power estimate consistent with existing searches.
concepts.coverage: Direct search example; no confirmed reservoir.

concepts.title: Dark-matter capture or annihilation as an energy reservoir
concepts.bounded_question: Could a surviving dark-matter model allow practical capture and controlled energy release?
concepts.mechanism_status: Generic dark-matter energy engineering remains a hypothesis
concepts.resource_ledger: Hypothesized particle flux and reaction energy; capture, containment and depletion.
concepts.main_gap: Identity, density, interactions, accessibility and actual energy-release mechanism.
concepts.next_investigation: Replace the generic label with a particle model and compare capture-rate bounds before engineering.
concepts.coverage: Adjacent constraints only; no direct harvester design verified.

concepts.title: Antimatter energy storage and naturally accessible antimatter
concepts.bounded_question: Can any realistic antimatter supply or storage route provide a useful energy service?
concepts.mechanism_status: Antimatter physics established; accessible fuel is a separate issue
concepts.resource_ledger: Manufactured antimatter consumes prior energy; a natural supply would need independent evidence.
concepts.main_gap: Production efficiency, containment, losses, radiation and supply.
concepts.next_investigation: Separate manufactured storage from natural harvesting; compare total supply-chain energy and useful output.
concepts.coverage: Laboratory background; application-specific corpus pending.

concepts.title: Black-hole rotational and accretion energy
concepts.bounded_question: Could accessible observations or eventual engineering exploit black-hole energy without assuming a ready-made generator?
concepts.mechanism_status: Astrophysical extraction mechanisms are theoretically grounded
concepts.resource_ledger: Black-hole spin or accreting matter; access, coupling and control resources.
concepts.main_gap: Access, stability, control, capture and useful delivery.
concepts.next_investigation: First study observable electromagnetic extraction and possible transferable plasma insights, separately from remote engineering scenarios.
concepts.coverage: Direct theoretical mechanism; human engineering remains speculative.

concepts.title: Hawking radiation and artificial black-hole power
concepts.bounded_question: Could a physically specified black hole supply controllable useful power?
concepts.mechanism_status: Semiclassical emission theory; artificial power system unestablished
concepts.resource_ledger: Black-hole mass and its creation or capture; conversion and lifetime constraints.
concepts.main_gap: Creating/accessing the object, lifetime, feeding and radiation handling.
concepts.next_investigation: Analyze mass, lifetime, emitted spectrum and full creation cost before making an engineering claim.
concepts.coverage: Direct theoretical foundation only.

concepts.title: Nuclear isomers and controlled excitation release
concepts.bounded_question: Can a specified long-lived excited nucleus serve as a practical controllable energy store?
concepts.mechanism_status: Low-energy nuclear-state spectroscopy demonstrated
concepts.resource_ledger: Energy invested in nuclear excitation or in producing an excited isotope.
concepts.main_gap: Charging cost, triggering, useful energy density, branching and safety.
concepts.next_investigation: Keep nuclear clocks separate from storage; require a complete excitation-and-release cycle.
concepts.coverage: Direct adjacent spectroscopy; not a high-energy storage demonstration.

concepts.title: LENR and anomalous low-temperature nuclear claims
concepts.bounded_question: Does a bounded anomalous heat or nuclear-signature claim survive independent calibrated testing?
concepts.mechanism_status: Claims are heterogeneous; selected experiments found no supporting effect
concepts.resource_ledger: Unknown claimed source; chemical, thermal and electrical alternatives must be excluded.
concepts.main_gap: Replication, calorimetry, contamination and nuclear-product consistency.
concepts.next_investigation: Preregister controls and energy accounting; reconcile heat with isotope and radiation diagnostics.
concepts.coverage: Direct negative investigation, not a universal impossibility proof.

concepts.title: Externally driven lattice-confinement nuclear reactions
concepts.bounded_question: Can externally driven lattice reactions provide useful net output or a non-power application?
concepts.mechanism_status: Irradiated deuterated-material experiments reported
concepts.resource_ledger: Incident radiation/beam energy plus nuclear reactants and target manufacture.
concepts.main_gap: Drive efficiency, reaction yield, target lifetime and net balance.
concepts.next_investigation: Retrieve the original reaction papers and calculate output relative to complete irradiation-system input.
concepts.coverage: Official experimental-program summary.

concepts.title: Dark energy, new interactions and genuinely unknown reservoirs
concepts.bounded_question: Could newly established physics reveal a locally accessible free-energy resource or conversion channel?
concepts.mechanism_status: Cosmological observations constrain models; no local harvester is established
concepts.resource_ledger: No reservoir is credited until a model specifies coupling, replenishment and conservation accounting.
concepts.main_gap: An observable cosmological parameter is not an engineering input; unrestricted unknowns are not testable.
concepts.next_investigation: Create separate falsifiable claims for candidate interactions, with explicit observables and surviving parameter space.
concepts.coverage: Cosmology and thermodynamic context only.

concepts.title: Reversible and adiabatic computing
concepts.domain: Demand reduction, computation and digital civilization
concepts.bounded_question: Can reversible architectures materially lower energy per reliable useful computation?
concepts.mechanism_status: Specific reversible gates and erasure experiments exist
concepts.resource_ledger: Switching, memory, I/O, control, error management and finite-speed operation.
concepts.main_gap: Finite-time dissipation, reliable reset, composability and system overhead.
concepts.next_investigation: Compare an end-to-end computation at matched error, latency and throughput rather than one gate.
concepts.coverage: Direct physical gate and thermodynamics seeds.

concepts.title: Neuromorphic and event-driven computing
concepts.domain: Demand reduction, computation and digital civilization
concepts.bounded_question: Can event-driven representations lower energy for scientifically or socially useful workloads?
concepts.mechanism_status: Task-specific low-power hardware demonstrated
concepts.resource_ledger: Hardware, sensing, learning, memory movement and task-matched performance.
concepts.main_gap: Workload dependence, accuracy and generalization.
concepts.next_investigation: Benchmark complete sensing-to-output tasks with equal accuracy and latency.
concepts.coverage: Direct hardware evidence.

concepts.title: Analogue and in-memory computing
concepts.domain: Demand reduction, computation and digital civilization
concepts.bounded_question: Can reduced data movement outweigh analogue variability and conversion overhead?
concepts.mechanism_status: Mixed-precision hardware computation demonstrated
concepts.resource_ledger: Compute, memory, calibration, ADC/DAC and digital correction energy.
concepts.main_gap: Precision, drift, endurance and workload mapping.
concepts.next_investigation: Compare full task energy with calibration and correction included.
concepts.coverage: Direct experimental evidence.

concepts.title: Photonic computing and optical interconnects
concepts.domain: Demand reduction, computation and digital civilization
concepts.bounded_question: Can optical processing or data movement reduce complete computational energy?
concepts.mechanism_status: Integrated photonic communication demonstrated
concepts.resource_ledger: Laser generation, modulation, optical/electrical conversion and memory.
concepts.main_gap: Full-system power, precision, programmability and integration.
concepts.next_investigation: Separate a front-end communication metric from complete compute-node energy.
concepts.coverage: Direct interconnect evidence; broad optical-compute claims need more sources.

concepts.title: Cryogenic and superconducting computing systems
concepts.domain: Demand reduction, computation and digital civilization
concepts.bounded_question: Can low-dissipation devices save more energy than refrigeration and interfaces consume?
concepts.mechanism_status: Relevant devices operate; system benefit is not automatic
concepts.resource_ledger: Device electricity plus refrigeration, heat leaks, wiring and reliability.
concepts.main_gap: Temperature-dependent cooling penalty and full system utilization.
concepts.next_investigation: Compare wall-plug energy at matched throughput, not only energy dissipated on the cold chip.
concepts.coverage: Device and cryogenic-engineering seeds.

concepts.title: Whole-brain emulation and individualized digital twins
concepts.domain: Demand reduction, computation and digital civilization
concepts.bounded_question: Can an individual brain be captured and emulated with validated functional fidelity?
concepts.mechanism_status: Large network models and connectomes exist; individualized emulation remains unestablished
concepts.resource_ledger: Imaging, state capture, compute, memory, cooling, embodiment and maintenance.
concepts.main_gap: Required biological detail, functional validation and complete resource demand.
concepts.next_investigation: Define a fidelity target and test predictive behavior on progressively richer validated models.
concepts.coverage: Direct adjacent simulations/anatomy plus historical roadmap.

concepts.title: Consciousness, personal identity and substrate transition
concepts.domain: Demand reduction, computation and digital civilization
concepts.bounded_question: What evidence could distinguish functional emulation, conscious experience and preservation of personal continuity?
concepts.mechanism_status: Competing consciousness theories are empirically investigated
concepts.resource_ledger: No energy saving is assumed before the target phenomenon and implementation are defined.
concepts.main_gap: No agreed single operational test settles identity or subjective continuity.
concepts.next_investigation: Separate empirical predictions from philosophical commitments and preregister tests where possible.
concepts.coverage: Direct theory-testing context; no upload or continuity proof.

concepts.title: Energy per validated cognitive service and subjective-time scheduling
concepts.domain: Demand reduction, computation and digital civilization
concepts.bounded_question: Could digital execution schedules and representations reduce resource needs per validated cognitive service?
concepts.mechanism_status: A proposed evaluation framework, not a demonstrated conscious-computing mechanism
concepts.resource_ledger: Total compute and support energy per agreed unit of service or experience; subjective time is unresolved.
concepts.main_gap: Defining equivalent cognition/experience, welfare and whether slower execution saves total energy.
concepts.next_investigation: Begin with measurable functional tasks; never equate a slower clock with lower total work or proven mind continuity.
concepts.coverage: Background only for the speculative target.

concepts.title: Passive radiative cooling and low-energy heat rejection
concepts.domain: Demand reduction, computation and digital civilization
concepts.bounded_question: Can radiative surfaces reduce real cooling-system energy and resource requirements?
concepts.mechanism_status: Below-ambient cooling under specified conditions demonstrated
concepts.resource_ledger: Heat rejected to the radiative environment; surface area and climate constraints.
concepts.main_gap: Sky conditions, heat loads, durability and urban integration.
concepts.next_investigation: Compare seasonal whole-building or process cooling energy with controlled baselines.
concepts.coverage: Direct experimental seed.

concepts.title: Circular materials, longer-lived infrastructure and resource efficiency
concepts.domain: Demand reduction, computation and digital civilization
concepts.bounded_question: Can reuse, durability and material substitution lower energy demand without reducing the required service?
concepts.mechanism_status: Systems-level hypothesis; technology-specific evidence varies
concepts.resource_ledger: Mining, manufacture, maintenance, collection, reprocessing and losses.
concepts.main_gap: Rebound effects, substitution tradeoffs and actual collection/recovery rates.
concepts.next_investigation: Use service-equivalent lifecycle boundaries and measured rather than ideal recycling fractions.
concepts.coverage: Background only; targeted lifecycle inventories pending.

concepts.title: Energy services and low-demand civilization scenarios
concepts.domain: Demand reduction, computation and digital civilization
concepts.bounded_question: Can a high-quality civilization operate with substantially lower material and energy throughput?
concepts.mechanism_status: Quantified service-demand scenarios have been modeled
concepts.resource_ledger: Energy for explicitly defined services, infrastructure and equitable access.
concepts.main_gap: Normative assumptions, distribution, transition cost and demand rebound.
concepts.next_investigation: Compare transparent service baskets and sensitivity to infrastructure and behavior assumptions.
concepts.coverage: Direct scenario-modeling seed.

concepts.title: Waste heat and planetary-scale carrying constraints
concepts.domain: Demand reduction, computation and digital civilization
concepts.bounded_question: What heat-rejection and environmental constraints remain even with abundant low-carbon power?
concepts.mechanism_status: Energy dissipation and modeled climate coupling are established
concepts.resource_ledger: Distinguish newly added heat from redirected natural energy fluxes and altered surface properties.
concepts.main_gap: Location, added versus intercepted flux, climate response and acceptable impacts.
concepts.next_investigation: Model source-specific heat budgets and spatial constraints rather than one unlimited-growth slogan.
concepts.coverage: Direct modeling and thermal-control seeds.
